title: ‘Simulacrum of Stories’: Examining Large Language Models as Qualitative Research Participants

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of LLM-generated interview responses using specific demographic personas, which revealed deficit framing for Latina personas and stereotypical tropes or caricatures for Black personas.

Qualitative comparison of simulated interview responses between explicit low-income, first-generation personas and unmarked personas, highlighting the model's reliance on unfounded meritocratic assumptions when demographics are not specified.

Qualitative thematic analysis of interactions with the LLM using intersectional personas (e.g., Black and non-binary), identifying how the model unnaturally foregrounds and oversimplifies complex identity traits rather than reflecting organic lived experiences.

Qualitative evaluation of LLM responses simulating individuals with cognitive impairments and d/Deaf community members, noting the generation of sanitized, 'by-the-book' responses that fail to capture the nuances and contradictions of lived experiences.
